About Vyom

Minimalist, zero-framework native desktop runtime

System Architecture

Native OS bindings with zero third-party framework overhead

  • Windows Backend: Win32 + Chromium Edge (WebView2 COM)
  • Linux Backend: GTK 4 + WebKitGTK 6.0
  • IPC Dispatcher: Compile-time FNV-1a Hash Table ($O(1)$ dispatch)
  • Asset Protocol: Virtual Host & Scheme Mapping • Zero local HTTP servers
  • Binary Footprint: ~50 KB native C executable
